title: Shoulders (DEWW day)
coachNote: Happy Thanksgiving. Chase the squeeze, not the weight. Tension on every rep.
progressionRule: Double progression: stay at a weight until every set hits the top of the range, then add.

warmup.instructions: Band pull-aparts 2x15, arm circles, then 1-2 light sets on the bar.

blocks.name: Seated barbell shoulder press
blocks.goal: Get a 9 or 10. At 3x10 add 5 lb per side.
blocks.swap: Hammer Strength or machine shoulder press

items.name: Seated straight-arm DB lateral raise
items.cues: Start DBs slightly in front, like lifting two heavy suitcases. Lead with elbows, arms straight.

items.name: Bent-arm (90 degree) lateral raise
items.cues: Last round only: finish with 15 partials, arms locked, hover 6 in off hips, out 6 in and back, squeeze.

blocks.name: Seated DB front raise
blocks.cues: Lean back a little, neutral grip, raise slightly toward center, stop just above shoulder height, no pause at the bottom.

items.name: Seated rear delt fly (2 grips)
items.cues: Bend fully forward, feet out front. Palms back (elbows to ears) 10-12, then palms forward 6-8 more, same DBs.

blocks.name: Seated DB shrugs
blocks.cues: Lean forward to stretch traps, sit tall, shrug up and back, pull with pinkies. Pick a weight and report it.
